html:
G'oya

Bu ikki usulning birikmasi. Birinchisi taqsimlash: har bir ball darajaga CASE bilan tushadi. Ikkinchisi pivot: har bir daraja alohida ustun, ya'ni guruh ichida COUNT(CASE ...). Ulushning maxraji imtihonga kelganlar, uni COUNT(score) beradi va u 0 bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun NULLIF kerak. Oxirida saralash NULL ni qayerga qo'yishni aniq aytishi kerak.

Yechim

SELECT subject,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score >= 86 THEN 1 END) AS excellent,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score BETWEEN 71 AND 85 THEN 1 END) AS good,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score BETWEEN 56 AND 70 THEN 1 END) AS satisfactory,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score <= 55 THEN 1 END) AS failed,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS absent,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN score >= 56 THEN 1 END)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(score), 0), 1) AS pass_pct
FROM results
GROUP BY subject
ORDER BY pass_pct DESC NULLS LAST, subject

COUNT(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 END) faqat shart rost bo'lgan qatorlarni sanaydi: qolganlarida CASE NULL beradi, COUNT esa NULL ni sanamaydi. Matematikadan Bekzod kelmagan: u absent da, lekin pass_pct maxrajida yo'q, natija 3 / 4 = 75.0. Tarixga hech kim kelmagan, ulush NULL va fan ro'yxat oxirida.

Tuzoqlar

COUNT ichida ELSE 0 yozish keng tarqalgan xato. 0 ham qiymat, COUNT uni sanaydi va hamma ustunda guruhdagi qatorlar soni chiqadi. ELSE 0 faqat SUM bilan ishlaydi.

Darajani "qolgani qoniqarsiz" deb yozsangiz, NULL ball ham shu yerga tushadi va Bekzod ikki joyda sanaladi: failed da ham, absent da ham.

Ulushni COUNT(*) ga bo'lsangiz, kelmaganlar ham maxrajga kiradi va Matematika 60.0 oladi.

Dialektlar farqi

Kamayish tartibida PostgreSQL NULL ni boshiga, SQLite oxiriga qo'yadi. NULLS LAST siz so'rov SQLite'da to'g'ri chiqadi, PostgreSQL'da esa Tarix ro'yxat boshiga o'tadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT subject,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score >= 86 THEN 1 END) AS excellent,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score BETWEEN 71 AND 85 THEN 1 END) AS good,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score BETWEEN 56 AND 70 THEN 1 END) AS satisfactory,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score <= 55 THEN 1 END) AS failed,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN score IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS absent,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN score >= 56 THEN 1 END)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(score), 0), 1) AS pass_pct
FROM results
GROUP BY subject
ORDER BY pass_pct DESC, subject

NULLS LAST ni ikkala baza ham tushunadi (SQLite 3.30 dan beri). Uning o'rniga saralashning birinchi kaliti qilib CASE WHEN COUNT(score) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END yozish ham mumkin.
